summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K batching nine LSE RNS announcements covering ordinary-share buybacks executed 16-28 October 2026 under the AGM authority granted 8 May 2025 and standing instructions issued 17 February 2026. Purchases were made through Goldman Sachs International at prices ranging roughly $165.85-$170.00, in small tranches (760-1,000 shares per day), with shares cancelled post-settlement; shares in issue fell to about 147,033,538 excluding 5,431,782 treasury. This mirrors a US issuer repurchase program. The negligible daily volume points to a drip buyback, so watch cumulative cancellation pace and liquidity rather than a deal spread.
